facts.fact: SNDI's CEO says the state-owned company, created in 1999, advises, deploys, develops, maintains and trains on ICT networks and tools across all ministries and state institutions, running a nationwide government intranet and VSAT WAN; document published 2014-12-16, no other date given.

SNDI, a state-owned company, says it developed and deployed SIGFIP (public finance) and SIGMAP (public procurement), used nationwide by the Government; document published 2014-12-16, no other date given.
